671:t_004:11.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This girl too has lost in love... You could call her my comrade.」

671:t_004:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't you dare lump $$ランカ$$ in with someone like you!」

671:t_004:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「We won't let you use $$ランカ$$ for your jealous ambitions to destroy everything and take it out on the world!」

671:t_004:14.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It is too late. Soon, a massive outbreak of $$バアル$$ will begin the great collapse that will destroy every universe.」

671:t_004:15.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I will watch it unfold and reminisce about my days of love with $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, now so far away.」

671:t_005:1.en:
$$カイエン$$
「He's brought out $$アルテア$$'s forces too!」

671:t_005:2.en:
$$ジン$$
「If he's attacking us, he must be absolutely sure he can beat us.」

671:t_005:3.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You bastard! Using a woman as your tool is your trump card?!」

671:t_005:4.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「We can't lose to someone like that!」

671:t_005:5.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「We must fight for $$ランカ$$... and for this universe!」

671:t_005:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「Hang on, $$ランカ$$! We're coming to save you right now!」

671:t_005:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It is useless, Wingless. You will meet your end in this sealed labyrinth of love and hatred.」

671:t_005:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Bring it on! You'd better have more than talk, $$ミカゲ$$!」

671:t_005:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We won't let your hatred swallow us or the universe!」

671:t_006:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You Wingless...! You refuse to die!」

671:t_006:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Of course we do! If we beat you here, we can get out of this cramped little space!」

671:t_006:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We have a reason to keep going, beyond your hatred!」

671:t_006:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「To the final battle with $$バアル$$...? You are so brave.」

671:t_006:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But even if you destroy it, your pathetic power will never defeat them.」

671:t_007:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Does he mean $$テンプティ$$ and the others?」

671:t_007:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You $$御使い$$! You dare trample through my heart?!」

671:t_007:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Hee hee hee... You are $$ミカゲ$$, rather than $$頭翅#pilot$$... For someone who claims his heart is closed, you seem to have left an opening.」

671:t_007:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Or are you waiting for someone? Someone you love who will save you from this place?」

671:t_007:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「In the end, you're all stuck halfway. You may be more than human, but far too much of your humanity remains.」

671:t_007:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It makes no sense for you to call yourselves $$天翅$$s. That's why the name $$堕天翅$$ suits you.」

671:t_007:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And so you imprisoned our home, $$アトランディア$$, in the gap between dimensions!」

671:t_007:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There, we could only await our chance! For over a hundred million years, doing nothing else!」

671:t_007:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then my brethren vanished one by one, and only my hatred remained...! Yes... my hatred for you and the world!」

671:t_007:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Oh, what a disappointment... If you're trapped by something like that, your power can't amount to much.」

671:t_007:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence! Now that I have the $$暗黒の翼$$, I will destroy the Wingless, then take my revenge on you!」

671:t_007:14.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You can't, you can't! It's pointless! You don't even understand the truth, and you're only halfway along the path to $$シンカ$$!」

671:t_007:16.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I came all this way to watch, but this is no fun. You can play with the Earthlings in your little world.」

671:t_007:18.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Don't talk to me like we're friends. I'm not sweet, adorable $$ティティ$$-chan.」

671:t_007:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I am a $$御使い$$... $$楽しみのテンプティ$$. You lot could never beat me, no matter how hard you tried.」

671:t_007:20.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So you arrogantly presume to rule over other species!」

671:t_007:21.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I'm not presuming anything. That's simply how things are.」

671:t_007:23.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Bye-bye, Earthlings! Can you beat a $$堕天翅$$ ruled by hatred~?!」

671:t_008:0.en:
$$シン$$
「That little...! Did she come here just to mock us?!」

671:t_008:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「She probably also came to flaunt her power by entering and leaving this space that we cannot escape.」

671:t_008:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!」

671:t_008:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I thank you, $$御使い$$! Thanks to you, my hatred has doubled!」

671:t_009:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This hatred will destroy you... and the world! Yes... everything!」

671:t_009:3.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Your song... is way too sad.」

671:t_009:5.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah. I felt your overflowing emotions... your soul.」

671:t_010:0.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Hey, $$バサラ$$! What are you talking about?!」

671:t_010:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「He's a $$堕天翅$$ trying to engulf the world in hatred!」

671:t_010:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「What do I care about that? I just took in his soul.」

671:t_010:3.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Besides, love, hatred, joy, anger, sorrow and pleasure are all human emotions!」

671:t_010:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「How can any of them be good or bad?!」

671:t_010:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I know what you mean, but...」

671:t_010:6.en:
$$カイエン$$
「He's keeping us trapped here, hoping the universe will be destroyed!」

671:t_010:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「He'll destroy himself before that happens.」

671:t_010:9.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Your song is just too sad.」

671:t_010:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「More than hatred or anything else, his heart is filled with sorrow.」

671:t_010:11.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「That's why he wants to destroy even himself along with the world.」

671:t_010:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence, Wingless! You have no right to intrude into my heart!」

671:t_010:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This $$暗黒の翼$$ is a trio of love, hatred and despair! You cannot break its harmony!」

671:t_011:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$ＹＦ－２９$$'s wings are resonating... This is...」

671:t_011:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「$$アイモ$$... It's $$ランカ$$'s song.」
